concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to download the CodeVulnBench dataset. Task T002 (and T007) note that the CodeVulnBench source has *no verified public URL* and the pipeline will abort if it is missing. This weakens the functional requirement by allowing the pipeline to run without the mandated dataset, violating FR-001.

SC-003 mandates that execution time be measured against the GitHub Actions free‑tier limit. T014 only verifies that a CSV with resource‑usage rows exists; it does not assert that the recorded wall‑clock times stay within the allowed limit, so the acceptance criterion is not enforced.

SC-004 requires memory usage to be measured against the 7 GB RAM constraint. T014’s verification again only checks for the presence of rows in the CSV, not that peak RSS values are ≤ 7 GB, leaving the success criterion unvalidated.

SC-005 (proportion of files successfully analyzed) is listed in the spec but no task includes a verification step that computes or checks this metric. The pipeline therefore lacks any evidence that this success criterion is satisfied.

SC-006 requires precision and recall of the static‑analysis tools to be measured against the human audit ground truth. Task T011’s verification only checks sample‑size calculation and false‑positive‑rate computation; it does not verify that precision and recall are calculated or reported, so the acceptance criterion is missing.

SC-007 (difference in False Positive Rates between groups) is a success criterion, yet T011’s verification only confirms that an FPR value is produced, not that a *difference* between groups is computed and evaluated.
